## Summary

Describe the research task, skill, documentation, code, or catalog change.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `python scripts/build_catalog.py`.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/validate_repo.py`.
- [ ] I ran `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
- [ ] Generated files are included and `git diff --exit-code` is clean after rebuilding.

## Provenance and licensing

- [ ] I created this contribution or have the legal right to submit it.
- [ ] I agree to the contribution-licensing terms in `CONTRIBUTING.md`, including distribution under PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 and the project copyright holder's right to offer the contribution under separate commercial terms.
- [ ] I identified all third-party code, skills, data, models, APIs, fonts, images, and other assets introduced by this change.
- [ ] I preserved all applicable copyright, license, provenance, trademark, and Required Notice information.

## Safety and research integrity

- [ ] The change does not contain credentials, private data, fabricated citations, hidden advertising, or unconditional execution instructions.
- [ ] Any medical, legal, ethical, privacy, or controlled-access boundary is stated explicitly.
